A logbook: forty years of trades, every one returned, every one signed. Ivo watches you read it, not offended in the slightest.
"Any time." Ivo goes back to his screens.

remembers.notice: Ivo sighs. "Fine. I'll do it in front of Officer Jenny." She is here, bored, eating a sandwich. It works.

addChoices.label: Trade it over, with Jenny watching.

success.text: Jenny watches the whole thing, chewing. "Huh," she says. "He did give it back."
